commit_message: Implement ADR 0126 Animation Timeline runtime adapter
pr_body: Implements the next ADR 0126 runtime slice on current main. Adds the Animation track adapter using Animation Set motion slots and exact Timeline-owned sample time, suspends and restores Animation Graph/Animator runtime state during Timeline overrides, rebuilds stable runtime bindings from scene identity, and registers Timeline in the shared Editor Play/packaged Player fixed-step schedule. Adds focused runtime/schedule tests and updates ADR 0126 implementation status. Audio/VFX adapters, persistent Scene View preview, curve/ReplayRequired reconstruction, and the packaged proving project remain separate follow-up slices.
